findings.observation: The 'Compare with last year' button advertises the year-over-year comparison that the stated purpose names. In E02 it was clicked on a fresh load (completed) and, within 1200 ms, no visible text or DOM state changed: the after screenshot A03 is byte-identical to the initial A01, and the comparison status line still reads 'Select a pollutant or a comparison above.' No comparison appears in the captured view.

summary.text: A plain, specific single-view dashboard: Verdana text, one muted green accent on outlined buttons, a single bordered reading panel, and copy that names the neighborhood, sensor model, correction formula, and month. No surface, template, or copy pattern from the codebook was observed. The slop-associated feature is behavioral: the 'Compare with last year' button, which carries the comparison named in the stated purpose, was clicked on a fresh load and produced no visible text or DOM change within 1200 ms; the after screenshot is byte-identical to the initial one. The sibling 'Show PM2.5' button worked under the same capture method, so the failure is specific to one control. A dead control is an observed failure, explained equally well by an ordinary bug or an unfinished feature, and says nothing about who or what made the page. The time-aggregation labels ('averaged over September 2026', 'Current reading', '8-hour average') are loosely matched and were recorded as a non-counted exception. The Download CSV link was not tested and is unknown, not broken.
major_limitations: One desktop viewport (1280x800) at scroll offset 0; no mobile viewport, full-page capture, or keyboard-focus states.
Each click was observed once on a fresh load within a fixed window (800 ms, 1200 ms); delayed results and combined interactions were not tested.
No source excerpts, so the cause of the dead control (SRC-01) cannot be examined.
The Download CSV link was not exercised; its behavior is unknown.
